p.name: Akinsikun Tosin
p.tag: Data Analyst · SQL · Power BI · Excel
p.bio: I turn raw numbers into clear answers. I’m building real projects with SQL, Excel, Python and Power BI, and I’m looking for a junior role where I can learn fast and be useful from week one.
p.ab:
I’m a new data analyst who enjoys finding the story hidden in numbers. I focus on understanding the business question first, then cleaning, exploring and visualising the data until the answer is clear.

I’m building a portfolio of hands-on projects and looking for a junior data analyst role or internship where I can learn from a strong team, take on real problems and grow quickly.
p.focus: Data Cleaning, Exploratory Analysis, Dashboard Design, Data Storytelling, Problem Solving, Clear Reporting

pr.d: Cleaning a public retail sales dataset and building a dashboard that shows revenue by month, region and product.
pr.ap: Importing the data, fixing data types and duplicates, then building a model and visuals for each question.
pr.o: Practising data cleaning, DAX basics and choosing the right chart for each question.

pr.d: Exploring why customers leave a subscription service, using Pandas to compare customers who stayed with those who left.
pr.ap: Cleaning the data, comparing the two groups and visualising the biggest differences.
pr.o: Practising exploratory analysis and explaining findings in plain language.

pr.d: Answering real business questions on a sample database.
pr.ap: Writing queries step by step, from simple filters to joins and window functions, and checking each result.

jy.p: Studying SQL, Excel, Python and Power BI through courses and daily practice.
Turning what I learn into projects that answer real questions with real data.

jy.t: Looking for my first data role
jy.p: Open to junior analyst roles, internships and entry-level projects.
